book.name: Jon
book.title: Jon Jon Bin Dalim Det Gudnyus Blanga Jisas Det San Blanga God

content: Wal Jisas bin kipgon tok, “Wal aibin dalim yumob tharran wulijim yumob kaan tenawei brom mi weya yumob bilib langa mi, dumaji dei garra andimwei yumob brom ola Juwish Miting Pleis,
en det taim garra kaman weya pipul garra trai en kilim yumob ded du, en wen dei trai en kilim yumob lagijat, dei garra reken dei dumbat wanim God wandim olabat blanga dumbat.
Bat dei nomo sabi main Dedi en mi. En blanga tharran na dei garra dumbat detlot ting langa yumob.

En aibin dalim yumob dijan bifo det taim garra kaman weya pipul garra dumbat detlot nogudbala ting langa yumob lagijat, wulijim wen det taim garra kaman, yumob garra jinggabat wanim aibin dalimbat yumob. Det wek blanga Holi Spirit “Wal ai nomo bin dalim yumob blanga detlot ting basdam, dumaji aibin iya garram yumob.
Bat ai garra gowei brom yumob na en gobek langa main Dedi hubin jandim mi. En nomeda aibin dalim yumob ai garra gowei, bat stil nobodi bin askim mi brabliwei weya ai garra go.
“Wal aibin dalim yumob weya ai garra go. En yumob brabli nogudbinji.

Bat trubala ai dalim yumob. If ai gowei, wal im mobeda blanga yumob, dumaji if ai nomo gowei, det Holi Spirit hu garra album yumob kaan kaman langa yumob. Bat if ai gowei, wal ai garra jandim im langa yumob.
“Wal wen det Holi Spirit garra kaman, im garra shoum ola pipul langa dijan wel dei nomo oldei jinggabat raitwei. Dei oldei reken dei jinggabat raitwei. Bat najing.
Dei oldei jinggabat rongwei blanga mi en dumbat nogudbala ting, dumaji dei nomo bilib langa mi. En det Holi Spirit garra shoum olabat dei nomo jinggabat raitwei blanga mi.

“En detlot pipul oldei jinggabat rongwei hau blanga jidan raitwei langa God, dumaji dei reken dei gin hendulum miselp. Bat det raitwei blanga go langa God im thru langa mi, dumaji ai garra gobek langa main Dedi deya langa hebin weya yumob kaan luk mi. En det Holi Spirit garra shoum detlot pipul dei nomo jinggabat raitwei blanga hau blanga jidan raitwei langa God.

“En detlot pipul oldei jinggabat rongwei blanga God weya im garra jadjim olabat, dumaji dei reken im kaan jadjim olabat. Bat im garra jadjim olabat, dumaji imbin olredi jadjim det bos blanga dijan wel. En det bos na im Seitin. En det Holi Spirit garra shoum detlot pipul dei nomo jinggabat raitwei blanga God weya im garra jadjimbat olabat.
“Wal ai garram loda wed blanga dalim yumob. Bat yumob kaan hendulum ol detlot wed tudei.

Bat wen det Holi Spirit weya oldei dalim yumob det trubala wed garra kaman, im garra meigim yumob sabi ebrijing. Bat im kaan dalim yumob im ronwan wed. Im garra dalim yumob wanim im irrimbat brom mi, en im garra dalim yumob blanga detlot ting weya garra hepin bambai,
en im garra shoum yumob mi brabli haibala, dumaji im garra dalim yumob wanim mi tok.
“Wal ebrijing main Dedi garram, olabat blanga mi du. En blanga tharran na aibin dalim yumob det Holi Spirit garra meigim yumob sabi ebrijing weya mi dalim im.
“Wal nomo longtaim na yumob kaan luk mi, en nomo longtaim afta yumob garra luk mi igin.” Lagijat na Jisas bin tok.
Det nogudwan taim garra tjeinjim miselp langa gudbala taim

Wal wen Jisas bin tok lagijat langa im wekinmen olabat, sambala bin askim miselp, “Wanim dijan im toktok? Im dalim wi nomo longtaim na wi kaan luk im, en nomo longtaim afta wi garra luk im igin. En imbin dalim wi im garra gobek langa im Dedi.
Wal wanim dijan wed nomo longtaim weya im toktok? Wi nomo sabi wanim im toktok.”

Wal Jisas bin sabi deibin wandi askim im kwestjan blanga wanim imbin toktok, en imbin dalim olabat, “Aibin dalim yumob nomo longtaim na yumob kaan luk mi, en nomo longtaim afta yumob garra luk mi igin. En blanga tharran na yumob askimbat miselp, indit?

“Wal yumob jinggabat det gel weya garra abum beibi. Im nogudbinji, dumaji det taim blanga im blanga abum det pein bin kaman na. Bat afta wen im abum det beibi, im nomo jinggabat det pein, dumaji im gudbinji blanga det beibi weya imbin abum. “Wal im lagijat du langa yumob. Trubala ai dalim yumob. Yumob garra nogudbinji en kraikrai detmatj. Bat ola pipul langa dijan wel garra gudbinji. En det taim weya yumob garra nogudbinji bin kaman na. Bat afta yumob garra jidan gudbinji, dumaji ai garra kambek en luk yumob igin. En det taim na yumob garra jidan brabli gudbinji, en nobodi kaan meigim yumob nogudbinji enimo.

“Wal wen det taim garra kaman, yumob kaan askim mi enijing. Yumob garra askim main Dedi. En im garra gibit yumob. Trubala ai dalim yumob. Main Dedi garra gibit yumob enijing yumob askim im langa main neim.
Yumob nomo bin askim im enijing langa main neim. Bat yumob garra askim im na. En yumob garra gedim wanim yumob askim im wulijim yumob garra jidan brabli gudbinjiwei.”
Jisas bin bidim dijan wel

Jisas bin kipgon tok, “Aibin yusum olkain stori blanga dalim yumob ol dislot ting. Bat det taim garra kaman wen ai kaan yusum olkain stori blanga tok langa yumob. Ai garra jis dalim yumob streidat blanga main Dedi.
En wen det taim garra kaman, yumob garra askim im enijing langa main neim. “Yumob sabi? Ai nomo tok ai garra askim im blanga yumob.
Yumob garra askim main Dedi yumob ronselp, dumaji im na laigim yumob. En im laigim yumob dumaji yumob laigim mi en yumob bilib aibin kaman brom im.
“Wal trubala aibin kaman brom main Dedi, en aibin kaman langa dijan wel. Bat ai garra gowei brom dijan wel na, en ai garra gobek langa main Dedi.”

Wal wen Jisas bin tok lagijat langa im wekinmen olabat, deibin dalim im, “Melabat sabi na yu sabi ebrijing, dumaji nobodi bin askim yu enijing. Bat stil yubin sabi wanim melabat bin jinggabat, en yubin tok streidat langa melabat. En tharran na meigim melabat bilib yubin kaman brom God.”
Wal Jisas bin dalim olabat, “Wanim? Yumob bilib dumaji aibin dalim yumob streidat?

Wal ai dalim yumob. Det taim garra kaman en im olredi iya weya yumob garra ol ranawei langa yumob ron kemp, en yumob garra meigim mi jidan miselp. Bat ai kaan jidan miselp, dumaji main Dedi jidan garram mi.

En aibin dalim yumob tharran wulijim wen im garra hepin, yumob garra jidan gudbinjiwei, dumaji yumob jidan wanbala garram mi. Nomeda ola pipul langa dijan wel garra gibit yumob trabul, bat stil yumob kaan bradin, dumaji aibin bidim dijan wel.” Lagijat na Jisas bin dalim im wekinmen olabat.
